summary: Read the entire 105829-character markdown conversion through the end of the references; the supplied 17-page PDF contains no appendix or embedded supplementary file. Checked the 11 requested estimates against PDF pp. 4-10, including in-memory visual inspection of the statistical passages and Figures 1, 4, 8, and 12. Two problems remain: the null se_basis codes for main-test and immediate-post-test elaboration are not permitted by the schema, and the paper does not establish a defensible replacement. All 11 quote-not-found alerts are matching false positives. Soft line-break hyphens split experimental in the main flexibility and H2 quotations, distributions in the main originality quotation, and signifcant in the shared retention quotation. Italic U, p, mean, and sd render correctly but extract as replacement characters; visual inspection confirms the elaboration results U = 924.0, p = 0.005 and U = 970.0, p = 0.012, and the immediate fluency values AI mean = 16.12, SD = 5.88 versus control mean = 14.38, SD = 4.55. All 46 source quotations attached to the checked estimates match their exact cited pages after only whitespace/soft-hyphen normalization and the visually confirmed italic-label mapping. The nonnull statistics belong to the stated outcomes and arms. Main/immediate counts of 52 people per arm, 104 people total, and 52 dyads total are printed in Section 4.3 and consistent with Figures 1, 4, and 8. Retention counts appropriately remain null: Figure 1 depicts individuals while Figure 12 labels dyads, and analysis-specific attrition and aggregation are not established. The remaining requested coding fields are consistent with the procedure and scoring: main with_ai, post-tests after_ai, immediate dyad work versus delayed individual retention, no randomized within-person crossover, and ai_vs_bau. Figure-only outcome values are appropriately omitted under extraction rule 1. The full extraction covers all four AUT outcomes at all three stages; no additional in-scope full-sample outcome or contrast was found under rules 4-6. The excluded pre-study has no people receiving randomized AI assistance; subgroup results, self-reports, process measures, and within-AI associations do not add eligible contrasts. The main fluency estimate was considered only for coverage and was not reverified.
